title: Text: DET Rick Anderson ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I’m not going to be down there. They moved me off the beat. Visiting a friend in Dunedin, was going to see if any of you guys were around early to stop by. Thank you for your help, I enjoyed getting to know you. I should be around at some point this season, I’m not quite sure, though - they burned me pretty bad and I’m looking for an exit. I’ll keep in touch.
Really? That’s not right. I feel bad for you! I appreciate all you’ve done, I’ve always enjoyed chatting with you. Yore always upfront and honest. Good luck,stay in touch
For sure, I appreciate that. Have a good spring
